title: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_SUPPORTS — Per-Model Capability Override Env Vars
description: New env var family: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS lets you override effort/thinking capability detection for pinned model IDs on Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure Foundry. Also adds _MODEL_NAME/_DESCRIPTION to customize /model picker labels. Enables correct capability routing when 3p-hosted pinned model versions differ from Anthropic's latest capability map.
notes: Low priority for direct use (running native Anthropic, not 3p-hosted). Document for completeness and for future if Bedrock/Vertex is adopted.

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic feature, trivial to set (env var), zero maintenance. However, capability expansion is near-zero for this workspace — we run native Anthropic (not Bedrock/Vertex/Azure), so the capability detection override has no practical application now. Decision for human: is this worth documenting in the registry for completeness, or is it noise? If Bedrock/Vertex adoption is ever planned, this becomes an APPROVED registry note. For now, human should decide whether to archive or document.
